input.icp: We sell RevOps analytics that gives sales leaders one trusted view of pipeline, for Series B+ B2B companies scaling their go-to-market team.

company.name: Northwind Pay
company.oneLiner: Payments and treasury software for mid-market finance teams.

signals.title: Raised an $80M Series C to double its GTM team
signals.snippet: Northwind Pay today announced an $80 million Series C round, which it will use to double its go-to-market team and expand into Europe.

signals.title: Hired its first VP of Revenue Operations
signals.sourceTitle: Welcoming our first VP of Revenue Operations
signals.snippet: We're excited to welcome Dana Okafor as our first VP of Revenue Operations, reporting to our CRO.

signals.title: 14 open go-to-market roles
signals.snippet: Open roles: Account Executive (6), Sales Development Representative (5), RevOps Analyst (2), Sales Engineer (1).

signals.title: Opened its first international office in London
signals.snippet: Northwind Pay has opened its first international office in London to serve customers across the UK and EU.

signals.title: Launched Northwind Treasury
signals.snippet: Today we're launching Northwind Treasury, giving mid-market finance teams real-time cash visibility across every bank account.

sentences.text: Congrats on the $80M Series C, and on the plan to double the go-to-market team.
Bringing on Dana Okafor as your first VP of Revenue Operations suggests pipeline reporting is about to get a lot more rigorous.
With 20 new sales reps starting this quarter, forecasting from a CRM that's still catching up gets painful fast.
Northwind was also named one of the fastest-growing fintechs of the year, so the board will be watching.
We help RevOps leaders get one trusted pipeline view across teams and regions, without another spreadsheet.
Worth a quick chat once Dana has settled in?

verdicts.rationale: The announcement states the $80 million Series C and the plan to double the go-to-market team.
verdicts.quote: an $80 million Series C round, which it will use to double its go-to-market team

verdicts.rationale: The hire is stated; the claim that reporting will get more rigorous is a reasonable inference, not a stated fact.
verdicts.quote: welcome Dana Okafor as our first VP of Revenue Operations

verdicts.rationale: The careers page lists 14 open go-to-market roles, including 6 Account Executive openings. It doesn't say 20 reps are starting this quarter.
Labelled generic, but states a fact about Northwind Pay with no source: named one of the fastest-growing fintechs of the year

sentences.text: With 6 Account Executive and 5 SDR roles open, forecasting gets harder quickly.

verdicts.rationale: The role counts match the careers page; 'forecasting gets harder' is an inference.

relevance.reason: Ties hiring growth to forecasting pain; could name one concrete outcome.

tone.reason: Warm and brief; the second sentence is slightly presumptuous.

spamRisk.reason: No hype words, links or false urgency.

sentence.text: I saw Northwind Pay also tripled revenue to $400M this year, which must be putting real pressure on the team.

verdict.rationale: The cited source covers the $80 million Series C. It says nothing about revenue, tripling or $400M.

contact.why: They just hired for this role and own the pipeline reporting this would improve.
